answer: Make standing a terrace an identity climbs tier by tier: each step up locks a larger non-refundable deposit inside a time-release vault, and credit is minted only by peer-graded work performed at that tier. Stop contributing and your standing spirals downward, forfeiting the locked vault. A sybil fleet gets no shortcut: to seat N fakes at a useful tier the attacker must independently climb and lock each one's escalating deposit, so cost grows as N times the full terrace, and every idle clone bleeds its vault back toward zero.
